Construction Site |first_appearance = [[Ducky Revenge Event]] }} ==Description== The '''Duck Realm''' is one of the many realms that exist within the world of Tower Defense Simulator. It was first canonically introduced in the [[Ducky Revenge Event]], where it was introduced as the home-realm for ducks. The realm is a giant bathroom which contains a giant bathtub, toilet and shelves, alongside a few other items placed on them. While a small window and a door do exist, the only area outside the bathroom shown is a pipe accessed through the toilet. The '''Duck Realm''' itself does not have a proper food source. Instead, the whole realm's food supply comes from the portal located in a toilet. In situations where this portal stops delivering food, the realm's population will begin to starve. There are multiple wooden tunnels built around the bathroom, which are used by the ducks to more easily travel between locations. ==Inhabitants== Ducks are the main inhabitants of the '''Duck Realm'''. They are all, with some slight exceptions, yellow ducks with black eyes, an orange beak and orange flippers. While their general look is the same, a lot of them vary in their shape, some being bigger like the [[Ducky Unit (Ducky Revenge)|Ducky Unit]] while others have longer necks like the [[Long Ducky (Ducky Revenge)|Long Ducky]]. These ducks hatch from eggs and grow up to be elderly ducks. There is one rarer type of duck, as these are only formed during most dire situations. If ducks are burdened with hatred and malice, they will slowly transform into [[Evil Ducky (Ducky Revenge)|Evil Duckies]]. This results in an appearance change, as the ducks turn black, grow red horns and have their eyes turn red. Their behavior also changes, as they become more hostile to other ducks.{{InlineQuote|Duckies burdened with malice and hatred slowly transformed into devilish ducks that cause mayhem wherever they waddle. [[Evil Ducky (Ducky Revenge)|Evil Duckies]] enjoy harassing the young ducklings, at least until [[Grandmother Ducky|Grandma Duck]] hits them with her cane.|[[Evil Ducky (Ducky Revenge)|Evil Ducky]]'s description in its [[Logbooks|Logbook]]}} Despite its name, penguins are also shown to inhabit the '''Duck Realm''' through [[P3NGU (Ducky Revenge)|P3NGU]]. ==Groups== The main faction in the '''Duck Realm''' is the Duck Army, a military group consisting of ducks. [[Mega Ducky|Mega Duckies]] are the generals of the army{{InlineQuote|[[Mega Ducky]] is the top of his class and the General Duck that leads the others into battle.|[[Mega Ducky]]'s description in its [[Logbooks|Logbook]]}} while all the military based duckies, like the [[Operator Ducky (Ducky Revenge)|Operator Ducky]], [[Ducky Unit (Ducky Revenge)|Ducky Unit]], [[Super Soldier Ducky]] or [[Elite Ducky]], are soldiers of the Duck Army. Ducks that would normally be seen as civilians, like the [[Mother Ducky (Ducky Revenge)|Mother Ducky]], are also members of the Duck Army.{{InlineQuote|Mother Ducky is the heart and soul of the Duck Army, keeping everyone in line with her firm but loving approach.|[[Mother Ducky (Ducky Revenge)|Mother Ducky]]'s description in its [[Logbooks|Logbook]]}} There are two smaller factions in the '''Duck Realm''' which are potentially subdivisions of the Duck Army. The first one is the Duck Air Force, which contains [[Flying Ducky (Ducky Revenge)|Flying Duckies]]. The second one is the Duck Intelligence Community, which contains the [[Agent Ducky (Ducky Revenge)|Agent]] and [[Spy Ducky (Ducky Revenge)|Spy Duckies]]. ==Locations== ===Toilet=== {{LocationInfobox |title = Toilet |image = DuckRealmToiletPortal.png |purpose = Food source }} The toilet located in the '''Duck Realm''' bathroom is the main food source for the realm. It is a large toilet located in the corner of the bathroom access through a rope. Once inside the toilet's pipes, there is a giant portal which is used to deliver bread to the realm. Other than the portal, the pipes also contain piles of trash. The portal located in this toilet broke during the events of [[Operation I.C.E Event]], which stopped it from delivering food. This is where the [[Nerd Duck (Story)|Nerd Duck]] finds a [[God Cube]] fragment planted there by the [[Narrator (Story)|Narrator]].{{InlineQuote|Once [[Ramiel]] used the card and messed up their portals, I hid a shard in their toilet!|'''Narrator''' on Wave 9 ([[Blind Faith]])}} The portal ends up getting reactivated by the end of the [[Ducky Revenge Event]]. The [[T.D.S. Organization]] are most likely the ones that have been delivering bread to this realm, as they are both blamed for it no longer being delivered by the ducks{{InlineQuote|You will pay for leaving us to starve like we were NOTHING! All of you!|[[Nerd Duck (Narrator)|Nerd Duck]] on Wave 33 ([[Bathroom Approach]])}} and directly called bread givers by them.{{InlineQuote|The Bread Givers are trying to stop us, KEEP ATTACKING!|[[Nerd Duck (Narrator)|Nerd Duck]] on Wave 1 ([[Bathroom Approach]])}} {{Clear}} ===Construction Site=== {{LocationInfobox |title = Construction Site |image = DuckRealmConstructionSite.png |purpose = Constructing [[Nerd Duck (Story)|Nerd Duck]]'s inventions }} Inbetween the bathtub and the shelf, there is a large construction site used by the ducks to build the [[Nerd Duck (Story)|Nerd Duck]]'s inventions. It contains a few scaffoldings made out of matches, sticks and gum. During cutscenes, [[Ducky D00M III]] and [[Bunny Sentry|Bunny Sentries]] are being made there, though it can be assumed that the [[Nerd Ducky|Mecha Bunny]] was also made there at one point. The entrance is guarded with a few walls and watch towers.[[File:DuckRealmConstructionSiteBarricade.png|280px]] The area is mostly populated by Welder Duckies which wear welding masks and hold various tools. ==Trivia== *In the opening cutscene for [[Bathroom Approach]], one of the ducks is called a ''Duck #7334'', implying the existence of 7,333 more ducks and giving the '''Duck Realm''' a minimal population of 7,334 ducks. **This is further supported later on in the same cutscene, as another duck, this time ''Duck #245'' appears, showing ducks numbered less than 7,334 do exist. ==Notes== {{StoryNavBox}}
